description_zh: 调用本接口查询转码用量数据
name: DescribeVodTranscodeData

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据结束时间点，需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The storage region. By default, data for all regions is returned. You can specify multiple regions separated by commas (,). Valid values:
cn-shanghai: Shanghai.
cn-beijing: Beijing.
eu-central-1: Germany.
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
存储地域。默认返回所有区域。支持批量查询，多个地域使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
cn-shanghai：上海。
cn-beijing：北京。
eu-central-1：德国。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity. Valid values:

day: day.
hour: hour
parameters.help_zh:
时间粒度。取值：

day：天。
hour：小时
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The storage name (Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket name). By default, data for all storage locations is returned. You can specify multiple storage names separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 存储名称（阿里云OSS存储Bucket名称）。默认返回所有存储。支持批量查询，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding specification. By default, data for all transcoding specifications is returned. You can specify multiple specifications separated by commas (,). Valid values:
Audio: audio-only.
Segmentation: container format conversion.
H264.LD, H264.SD, H264.HD, H264.2K, H264.4K, and more
parameters.help_zh:
转码规格，默认返回所有转码规格。支持批量查询，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：
Audio：音频。
Segmentation：转封装。
H264.LD、H264.SD、H264.HD、H264.2K、H264.4K等
parameters.name: specification

parameters.help_en: The application ID. If you specify this parameter, transcoding usage data for the specified application is returned. By default, transcoding usage data for all applications is returned. You can obtain the value of this parameter from the AppId response parameter of the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。传入此参数，可以查询指定应用下的转码用量。默认返回所有应用的转码用量数据。本参数值可以从[CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~)接口的返回参数`AppId`获取
parameters.name: app_id

DataInterval.description_en:
The time granularity of the returned data. Valid values:
hour: hourly data.
day: daily data
DataInterval.description_zh:
返回数据的时间颗粒度。取值：
hour：小时数据。
day：天数据
